description: A script for flashing firmware on Linksys ADSL2MUE devices, involving network device discovery and FTP-based firmware upload.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with additional methods for interacting with ADAM2 devices, including environment variable retrieval and reboot command.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends the USER command to the FTP server.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables from the FTP server.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variables.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends the REBOOT command to the FTP server.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device via FTP.
